stem:
The histogram shows the total number of swimmers in different age groups who participated in a swimming competition.

Based on the histogram, which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: There were 15 swimmers who were younger than 30 years old.

options.label: B
options.text: A total of 10 swimmers were 50 years old or older.

options.label: C
options.text: The number of swimmers who were 40 years old or older is less than the number of swimmers who were 29 years old or younger.

options.label: D
options.text: A total of 70 swimmers participated in the competition.

visual_elements: Histogram titled 'Ages of Swimmers' with Age (years) on the x-axis (20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59) and Number of Swimmers on the y-axis (increments of 5 to 20). Bars show: 20-24 -> 5 swimmers, 25-29 -> 10 swimmers, 30-34 -> 20 swimmers, 35-39 -> 10 swimmers, 40-44 -> 15 swimmers, 45-49 -> 3 swimmers, 50-54 -> 4 swimmers, 55-59 -> 8 swimmers.
